steps.content: [Bureau]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is Chief still not awake?

Hecate stays by the Chief's bedside, refusing to leave. Hours have passed since the guards first detected the strong fragrance emanating from the Chief's lounge. Despite every effort, Chief shows no signs of waking up. Meanwhile, Nightingale continues her investigation into the suspicious picture book.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Master is experiencing fatigue and requires rest, as would a human.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: That's right! Stop frowning, Hecate. He's probably just exhausted and catching up on sleep. I'm sure he'll wake up soon. Maybe he's feasting in his dreams right now.
steps.female_content: That's right! Stop frowning, Hecate. She's probably just exhausted and catching up on sleep. I'm sure she'll wake up soon. Maybe she's feasting in her dreams right now.

steps.content: [Castle Gallery]

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: What do you think of this fish necktie?

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Then surely you'll like these little brooches made of rat flesh?
You're wrapped in putrid, decaying rags that barely resemble formal clothing. Fighting back the urge to vomit, you force a strained smile.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: What about these? An intestine belt and semiconductor wings! You'll surely be the most dazzling person in the hall, second only to Graves!

In a side hall on the second floor of Morveth Castle, the mechanical girl known as No. 15 bounces excitedly among the ruins, completely absorbed in this dress-up game. But as the newlywed-to-be, you don't share in her delight.

Though you still can't remember how you arrived here, you've gradually grown accustomed to the Mania permeating the castle. Slowly, you're reconnecting with the shackles, and your instincts and experience in handling Mania incidents are beginning to resurface.
Resolving the Sinner's obsession with weddings will break this Mania space—could it really be that simple? That flickering black shadow on Graves fills you with unease.

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: I'm not good enough. There must be something. Think! Is my hair a mess? Did I wear my veil wrong? Am I too thin? And that most important thing... he can't find out...
steps.female_content: I'm not good enough. There must be something. Think! Is my hair a mess? Did I wear my veil wrong? Am I too thin? And that most important thing... she can't find out...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: If he finds out, he will hate me, abandon me!
steps.female_content: If she finds out, she will hate me, abandon me!

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: Careful, Graves! He's getting closer, he's going to see us like this, see how ugly we truly are! Then we'll never deserve happiness again!
steps.female_content: Careful, Graves! She's getting closer, she's going to see us like this, see how ugly we truly are! Then we'll never deserve happiness again!

steps.content: [Exit flashback]

Graves seems to converse naturally with her, as if entirely accustomed to her presence. She even refers to herself and Graves collectively as "we"... You turn your attention to No. 15, who's busily focused on dressing you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No. 15, is it alright if I call you that? Graves chose you to help, so you must know her quite well?

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Of course. Graves has been in this castle since she was young. She witnessed each of us come into existence. It makes me a bit emotional to think that Graves has finally found a partner of her own... Hmm, you've got quite a slim waist.
No. 15 responds while continues working without pause.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Come to think of it, we're actually quite alike. Just like you, I was created because someone came to the castle, wishing to meet their true love. I'm manifested by a wish, too. Lift your foot.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: But I'm less fortunate. My guy was so fickle. One moment he thought I wasn't as cool as some superhero, the next he complained I wasn't as obedient as a house elf, and well, you can see the result—
She makes a face with her misshapen body.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Hehe... Anyway, it was all so long ago. I don't even remember what kind of person I used to be, but this is fine too. Thanks to him wanting fifteen different types of lovers, I ended up with the name No. 15!
No. 15's tone is upbeat, but you can still tell this isn't exactly a happy story.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Seeing how Graves longs for marriage, I assumed all the love stories that took place here were beautiful ones.

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: ...It will be. I believe she'll find the most beautiful love. Because... she found you!
As she speaks, she holds a mirror up to your face.
[Grotesque Deformed NPC Silhouette]

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: I get it, say no more. My brilliant styling has left you doubting if that's really you in the mirror.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your sense of beauty has been completely twisted by whoever made those wishes!

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: Huh? Should I replace the intestine belt with lace instead?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not the point!

Ignoring your protests, No. 15 continues rummaging tirelessly through her collection of scraps. You look at her more closely now, realizing the wish-maker didn't imbue her with any expectation of love—only the careless marks of indecision.

Perhaps it's because she can't change what happened to her that she genuinely wishes for Graves's happiness. And perhaps her distorted sense of beauty isn't entirely her fault, given she's merely a wish vessel. You recall that the shadow once said something similar:

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: He doesn't like us? Then what's his type? We can become whatever he wants!
steps.female_content: She doesn't like us? Then what's her type? We can become whatever she wants!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No. 15, does Graves have any other close friends? The kind she would share all her secrets with?

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content: If anyone could get Graves to open up... it would probably be you.

Oblivious to your intention, No. 15 contentedly straightens the edges of your coat. You glance at your utterly hideous reflection in the mirror, then look down at the monstrous outfit adorning your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Talking to herself? To another side of... her?
[Red flash] [Heartbeat]
Your shackles react again, sensing the aura of that shadow attached to Graves. "It" is still agitated, active, prowling nearby! You grab No. 15 by the arm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where is Graves now?

The mechanical girl, completely unaware of the urgency, watches as the anxious Chief abandons the formal attire she had so meticulously prepared, hastily throws on a gray trench coat, and strides in the direction she pointed. Only then does she realize she forgot to tell the Chief:
That direction leads to an endless maze.
